items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And Gladys was the pianist of Ina Ray Hutton's band.

ctx.x: It goes back farther than that. When I -- I met Gladys Mosier in Pittsburgh while I was working at the Benjamin Harris Literary Club.
And Gladys was the pianist of Ina Ray Hutton's band. So she had mentioned that --
Well, I mean all the musicians when they played Pittsburgh would wind up at the Benjamin Harris Literary Club because it was an after hours spot. And I got a lot of encouragement there.
